title: [29.x][Subscription Billing] Sales-Explode BOM fails for foreign-currency customers
summary: Sales Subscription Line creation now correctly handles cached Sales Line data during BOM explosion for foreign-currency customers, preventing 'does not exist' errors.
key_points: Changed GetDate() to use GetSalesLine() method that checks cached Sales Line first
Resolves failures when exploding Assembly BOMs on sales orders with foreign currencies
Prevents unnecessary database lookups when Sales Line is available in memory
Added test coverage for the foreign-currency BOM explosion scenario
quote: Replace the direct SalesLine.Get() call with GetSalesLine(SalesLine) so the existing cached Sales Line is reused before falling back to the database lookup.
